Per the Comfort Club overview (membership/comfort_club_overview.md), Comfort Club members get a waived $89 diagnostic fee on all service calls, 15% off all repairs (parts and labor), priority scheduling ahead of non-members, no after-hours dispatch fee on emergency calls, two seasonal tune-ups per year (one cooling, one heating), and annual reminder and filter-change notifications.
The standard plan is $189 per year per system or $16.99 per month, and Comfort Club Plus is $269 per year per system.
The 2026 Repair Price Book also lists the seasonal tune-up at $129, included for members.
The documents do not say whether these benefits apply to a visit booked on the day of joining, so I can't say whether joining would save you money on this repair.
